S0.sources.definition: raw input files with size and SHA-256 prefix (first 64 MB)
S0.sources.note: sha over first 64 MB only for files >64 MB

S1.polygon_counts_match_centroids.definition: per-year polygon count equals per-year centroid count for every year 2018-2025

S1.centroid_offset_m.definition: planar distance between landslide_centroids.csv coordinates and the polygon centroid

S1.event_label_mismatches.definition: records whose event name differs between the centroid table and the shapefile

S1.area_max_abs_diff_ha.definition: largest absolute difference in mapped area

value.rule: trigger == rainfall AND forest_type in the six analysed classes

S2.case_selection_rule.definition: the filter that reproduces the case rows of step1_dataset.csv exactly

S2.case_ft_sequence_identical.definition: the forest-type sequence of the filtered centroid table equals that of step1_dataset cases, row for row

S2.terrain_max_abs_diff.definition: largest absolute difference between recomputed terrain and step1_dataset, over the 7,454 cases

S2.slope_vs_horn.definition: difference between the Horn slope and the slope actually stored in step1_dataset
S2.slope_vs_horn.note: the stored slope is Zevenbergen-Thorne, not Horn

S3.forest_map.definition: Fourth Forest Resource Inventory type map summary

S3.case_forest_type_agreement.definition: forest type recomputed at the polygon CENTROID vs the published overlay_result.csv

S3.control_counts_match.definition: forest type recomputed at the 50,000 background points vs the control composition of step1_dataset

S4.control_match.definition: recovery of control coordinates by matching all six terrain covariates against the background points

S4.residual_after_completion.definition: largest covariate mismatch after monotone completion of the control mapping

S5.headline_interaction.definition: bamboo x slope interaction odds ratio per degree, published specification
S5.headline_interaction.source: step1_dataset.csv (published) and the independently rebuilt table

S5.spline_curve_reproduction.definition: spline odds-ratio curve evaluated on the published grid (6-62 deg by 2), compared with results.json E4

S5.crossover_published_design.definition: crossover = interpolated slope at which the fitted log odds ratio changes sign on the frozen grid 5.0-60.0 deg step 0.1; protection band = slopes whose delta-method 95% upper bound is below 1

published.desc: bamboo x slope interaction, event-cluster-robust (sandwich) SE clustered by event

S5.event_cluster_robust.definition: event-cluster-robust (sandwich) standard errors, controls in one cluster
S5.event_cluster_robust.note: the published E6 used 40 clusters; the exact control-cluster convention is not recorded in the repo

S5.size_sensitivity.definition: interaction refitted with cases restricted to landslides at or above an area threshold

S5.full_coefficients.definition: complete coefficient table of the published specification

S5.model_fit.definition: fit statistics of the published specification

S5.vif.definition: variance inflation factors, before and after centring slope

value.evaluation: design_info of the fitted model reused; covariates cancel in the bamboo contrast

value.rule: a 5 km grid cell belongs to an event's footprint if it intersects the bounding box of any polygon of that event

S6.event_fixed_effects.definition: logit with event fixed effects; controls restricted to the footprint of each event

S6.footprint_sensitivity.definition: event fixed-effects interaction under six footprint definitions

S6.new_control_pool.definition: an independent control sample drawn uniformly inside the union of event footprints, typed with the official forest map and given terrain from the DEM

S6.new_pool_models_mc.definition: event fixed-effects interaction on the new control pool, mean over 25 independent control draws (seeds 1000-1024); MC range = 2.5-97.5 percentile of the point estimates across draws

S6.each_control_once_mc.definition: event fixed-effects interaction with every control assigned to exactly one event, mean over 25 draws (seeds 3000-3024)

S6.polygon_cells.definition: 20 m DEM cells whose centre falls inside each rainfall landslide polygon

S6.source_point.definition: forest type and terrain taken at the highest DEM cell inside each polygon (the rule the manuscript describes in section 2.3 but which the main analysis does not use)

S6.polygon_representation.definition: the interaction re-estimated with the landslide represented by different points or by all its cells
S6.polygon_representation.source: dem_20m.tif + annual shapefiles + rebuilt control table
S6.polygon_representation.note: random_cell uses seed 2026; all other rows are deterministic

S6.historic_inventory.definition: pre-study-period event inventory used to flag reactivated scars

S6.reactivation_rates.definition: share of points falling inside a 2004-2017 mapped landslide polygon

S6.polygon_geometry.definition: geometry of the 7,454 rainfall landslide polygons in forest

definitions.reliably_shallow: area < 1 ha AND not on a 2004-2017 scar AND >200 m from a debris-flow torrent AND outside large-landslide potential areas
definitions.all_screens: reliably_shallow AND >200 m from a national/provincial road AND >200 m from a river polygon

S6.screens.definition: the interaction re-estimated after removing the failure types listed in the failure-type screen

S6.relief_truncation.definition: how many bamboo cases above 40 degrees survive each relief restriction
S6.relief_truncation.note: explains why the relief-restricted subsets lose the steep-slope leverage

S6.misclassification.definition: non-differential and one-directional forest-type misclassification simulated on the analysis table
S6.misclassification.note: bounds the effect of the gap between the 2017 forest map and the 2018-2025 inventory

S6.three_level.definition: forest type entered as three levels (broadleaf reference, bamboo-broadleaf mixed, pure bamboo), each with its own slope interaction; the likelihood-ratio test asks whether the two bamboo-containing types share one interaction

S6.bamboo_definition.definition: pure bamboo versus bamboo-containing stands, and the effect of removing the two events that carry most bamboo cases

pooled.event: 丹娜絲颱風、薇帕颱風、0721豪雨

value.rule: events with at least 15 bamboo cases and at least 200 controls inside the event footprint

rows.dropped: 丹娜絲颱風、薇帕颱風、0721豪雨
利奇馬颱風、0815豪雨、白鹿颱風

S6.leave_one_event_out.definition: the interaction refitted 39 times, each time removing all cases of one event

S6.crossover_bootstrap.definition: cluster bootstrap of the crossover: events resampled with replacement (all their cases), controls resampled with replacement; crossover interpolated on the frozen grid

S6.curve_statistics.definition: crossover, significant-protection band and pointwise odds ratios under the frozen slope grid

S6.common_support.definition: slope distribution of bamboo and broadleaf control points, by 10-degree bins

S6.event_structure.definition: cases per rainfall event in the bamboo-versus-broadleaf subset

S7.irls_crosscheck.definition: the headline coefficient re-estimated with a hand-written Newton-Raphson solver and an analytically inverted information matrix, independent of statsmodels

S7.bspline_basis_crosscheck.definition: the whole spline path rebuilt without patsy: scipy BSpline.design_matrix for the basis, statsmodels Logit on a hand-built design matrix, contrast formed by hand

S7.delta_vs_simulation.definition: the delta-method standard error of the log odds-ratio curve compared with a 20,000-draw multivariate-normal simulation of the parameter vector

S7.crossover_invariance.definition: the crossover recomputed with the non-slope covariates set to their 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles; they cancel in the bamboo contrast, so the value must not change

value.method: exact conditional likelihood (elementary symmetric polynomial dynamic program), validated against statsmodels ConditionalLogit to 7e-06

S6.event_by_block_clogit_exact.definition: conditional logistic regression stratified by event x spatial block, exact likelihood, mean over 10 independent control draws

value.breslow_cox_vs_exact: Breslow tie handling in a stratified Cox model is NOT equal to conditional logistic regression when strata contain many cases; on a 60-stratum simulation the coefficients differed by 1.9e-01
value.decision: all conditional-logit results are reported from the exact implementation; the earlier Breslow-tied numbers are superseded

S7.clogit_method.definition: validation of the conditional logistic regression implementation

S2.step1_rows.definition: row counts of the published model-input table step1_dataset.csv

S6.aux_layers.definition: feature counts of the official auxiliary layers used for failure-type screens
S6.aux_layers.source: ARDSWC debris-flow torrent layer; large-landslide potential areas (2026); national/provincial road layer; WRA river polygons; 2004-2017 event inventories

S8.fig4_plot_cap.definition: Figure 4 draws at most 1,500 scatter dots per forest type; statistics on the figure use the full sample
S8.fig4_plot_cap.note: display thinning only; the model uses all samples

S8.removed_claim_avoided_landslides.definition: the 'roughly 1,062 landslides' figure in the earlier version of the text, an association-level extrapolation without calibrated baseline incidence
S8.removed_claim_avoided_landslides.source: earlier version of the text, section 3
